@Gideon Sato: your first report was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in this channel: "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant... Guard is writing trailer numbers on a clipboard."

The channel only records one other thing about the guard. At 11:03 AM Mateo wrote that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Nothing else in the channel says what the guard did between 10:42 and 11:03.
